create_evaluator_for_task: create an Evaluator instance for a task like s2ef, is2rs, or is2re with default metrics
run_evaluator_eval: run evaluator.eval with prediction and target dictionaries to compute performance metrics
compute_mae_metric: compute the mean absolute error between predicted and target tensor values
compute_cosine_similarity: compute cosine similarity between predicted and target force vectors
compute_energy_forces_within_threshold: compute the fraction of systems where energy and force errors are within thresholds
